name: Micromajig
subtitle: Ambassador M0d3 Un10ck3d
flavor:
To understand why these little things would be divisive, one must first understand the fact that the culture of invention in Acrolos is deeply seated in the traditions of voidal engineering practiced by the 31v35, who comprise a very significant portion of the community there. Since the first 31f expatriates settled in Turncrank Gorge in the days of old Marmothoa, they have practiced a small but strict, almost religious, set of tenets governing their art. One of these tenets is the stalwart abhorrence of mass production. The creation of one device that is the exact copy of another is not just uninteresting, but actively offensive to nearly all 31v35.* In stark contrast to this ban, the micromajig is so ubiquitous as to be regarded by many as a mundane nuisance.
* It is not known if the source of this distaste for duplication is grounded in historical experience or a merely religious aversion. Presumably, an answer exists, but it is nearly impossible to have a mature conversation with a male 31f, and nearly all the female 31v35 have sequestered themselves on N1d14, which we call Nidia.
notes: Token card: no cost number printed, no threshold. Rarity slot reads TOKEN. The whole text box is italic flavor plus an italic asterisk footnote; no rules text (catalog has none either).
